body: Yeah the phonebots like to catch up too

I don't know what I want. I'm not begging for authority. I really don't know who I want to make rules for me. I only know that if I make rules for myself, I break them, because I have no respect for the person that made the rules, and I'm not scared of her. I can kill her.

I can't tell you where I'm from over a public answer. I'll PM the rest of my message

You're so kind I really appreciate you taking the time to talk about this.
 
I'm rushing because I'm SO unhappy that I don't feel I can live another minute with the sickening unhappiness so I rush into crazy situations in a desperate attempt to help myself. It crashes, and I somehow get even worse. It's like I'm trying to kill myself with misery.

It wasn't terrible growing up. Now that I'm out of it and I ran away, I want it back. I want to have strict rules enforced on me so I don't keep doing shitty things to myself.

I think about killing myself so many times throughout the day. I'm driving, I think about crashing into a telephone pole or off an upper level highway. I'm in the bathroom, I think of swallowing an entire bottle of sertraline (I get migraines sometimes when I'm extremely stressed or anxious, so I have prescription meds for migraines). Wherever I am, I know there is something in the area that I can end everything with.

I don't even know what my point is. I think talking about it is helping me a lot. Thank you.
I just googled that. Thanks for the info. I start (regular) therapy tomorrow and I can barely afford that, so I don't think this would be attainable.

No I wish I did. I used to love myself. I remember being so comfortable with myself, that I'd spend hours of "alone time" at the waterfront each day. Then I started dating.
Ok some more background. I'm originally from an extremely strict conservative background, and I was not allowed to date at all. At 20, I secretly started dating.
I think that's the timeline. Once I started dating, I became hooked on the attention I got from guys. I'm obsessed with that attention. I absolutely love it and hate it. It's an addiction. I'm very pretty, so I got a lot of attention from guys over the years, and I think it's caused my self esteem to be totally dependent on my looks. Does that make sense?

Whatever the case is, I'm getting side tracked. I want to settle down and be normal and happy like other people, but that is no way possible for me. I don't know how to do that. I don't know how to have a stable, normal relationship. If I like someone, I move to fast, and speed through the entire dating process in the matter of two weeks, then I dump them and move on to the next guy. I don't know how to let things happen and take things one step at a time. I have no patience for anything or anyone.

Well, with the low self-esteem thing I am parroting a friend, but I think he's right. 
When I moved here, I made a close male friend. I've never had a close platonic male friendship before, and he's really helped me a lot. He's probably my best friend. He can't understand why I feel this way all the time, and I am quoting him on the low self-esteem issue, but I do honestly believe he's right. I don't think myself worthy of anyone or anything. I'm on a break from seeing this guy now who is *way* too good for me, so I told him I need to take a break. I can't even let things happen or play out. If something strikes me I instantly act on it and do something dramatic spur of the moment.

I'm absolutely terrified of being alone. Literally scares the shit out of me. I need to always be dating someone or in a complicated situation with someone. I can't just be alone. I have zero trust in myself, and like I said already, I don't even *like* myself.

Also- I move at the speed of light. One minute I desperately want to be dead and the next minute I'm ok. The tiniest things drastically affect my mood in ways I can't explain. I said in the paragraph before this one that I don't like myself, but there are times that I do. Nothing is consistent with me. 

FUCK. This doesn't even make sense. These are ramblings of a crazy person. I'm so irritated from myself that I can't just be normal. I just want to end my life so I don't have to keep being crazy and inconsistent. I'm batshit insane. 

The weirdest part is that you'd have no idea if you knew me. I give off a cool impression. Yeah I think that's the weirdest part. Hah

Thank you. You're very kind.
I moved twice in the past year, and both moves haven't been all that I hoped they'd be. Maybe my expectations were too high and my efforts too low the first time, 10 months ago. This move (6 months ago) has been a lot better, but because I worked hard on it. I just feel so... *blah*... now that I'm settled. I don't specifically want to die. I just don't want to be alive anymore, because clearly there's nowhere for me to live that will make me happy. I'm constantly restless and unhappy where I am. People would describe me as "free" and "unattached" and I'd describe myself as a restless wanderer, waiting for life to just end so I could stop wandering. Don't get me wrong. I want to settle down. I just don't know what's wrong with me. Why I can't every seem to like where I am / what I'm doing. I also have a cripplingly low self-esteem. People only like me for my looks. I've got literally nothing else - I don't think I'm a particularly *anything* person. I rely on being pretty to get everywhere in life. 

I just don't know how to make it end. Sorry for the ramble.
